{"command": "cd "$(pwd)" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os
allowed = {"off_by_one","mutable_default","shadowed_builtin","wrong_except","integer_division","unclosed_resource"}
d = json.load(open("findings.json"))
src = sorted(f for f in os.listdir("src") if f.endswith(".py"))
print("src files :", src)
print("json keys :", sorted(d.keys()))
print("keys match:", sorted(d.keys()) == src)
print("count==6  :", len(d) == 6)
bad = {k:v for k,v in d.items() if v not in allowed}
print("bad values:", bad)
print("all values allowed:", not bad)
EOF"}
